question: Which of the following state government launched the long-awaited policy of manufactured sand in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The state government of** Rajasthan**__ launched the long-awaited policy of manufactured sand in January 2021.
 
• On 25th January 2021, Rajasthan Chief Minister Shri Ashok Gehlot released Rajasthan **M Sand Policy 2021**.
 
• **The policy aims to fulfil the demand for river sand for construction works across the state.**
 
• The M Sand policy will reduce dependency on the river sand and boost the use and production of M-Sand in Rajasthan.
 
• The policy gives industry status to the units producing it for construction work and reduces the dependence on bajri (riverbed sand).
 
• The Supreme Court had banned illegal mining on riverbeds in 2017.
 
• The policy would help create employment opportunities through new units and resolve the issue of huge quantities of waste generated in the mining areas.
 
• The policy will enable the investors to set up M-sand units by utilising the incentives and facilities offered by the State government.
 
• It will also help in environmental protection and generate faith among the public in the efficacy of M-sand for construction works.
